same result for reversed input? true

BAD_NO_TIEBREAK on d1 reversed : [Falcons(9,6), Eagles(9,6), Bisons(9,4), Panthers(9,4), Lions(6,3), Anacondas(6,1), Cobras(6,1), Zebras(3,0)]
